title: Italian Flaxseed Pancakes
description: A twist on traditional pancakes, these Italian flaxseed pancakes are a delicious breakfast option. The flaxseed adds a nutty flavor and crunch to the pancake.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together flaxseed, flour, sugar, and salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk together eggs, milk, crumbled pancakes, and melted butter.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until just combined. Do not overmix.
The batter should still be slightly lumpy.
Heat a non-stick pan or griddle over medium heat.
Drop the batter by 1/4 cupfuls onto the pan.
Cook for 2-3 minutes, until bubbles appear on the surface and the edges start to dry.
Flip the pancakes and cook for another 1-2 minutes, until golden brown.
Serve warm with your favorite toppings.
Store leftovers in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 3 days or freeze for up to 2 months.
